entities.name: Darien Kjeld
entities.description: King of Kjeldor at the end of the Ice Age who fused Kjeldor with Balduvia into New Argive.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation ruled by Darien from the capital Krov.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation formed by merging Kjeldor and Balduvia.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Archmage who prevented an attack on Darien and aided him.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Helped Jodah prevent the attack on Darien's life.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Order that attempted to kill Darien.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Necromancer behind the attack on Darien.

entities.name: General Varchild
entities.description: General of the single army Darien formed.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Balduvian ally of Darien in the war against Lim-Dûl and the merger of nations.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Zombie leader of Stromgald who dueled Darien and was killed.

entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Battle of New Argive against the forces of Stromgald.

events.summary: Darien takes the throne of Kjeldor on his mother's death in 2933 AR.
events.quote: Darien ascended to the throne upon the death of his mother in 2933 AR

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya Ballard prevent an attack by the Knights of Stromgald on Darien and reveal Lim-Dûl's involvement.
events.quote: prevented an attack on Darien's life by the Knights of Stromgald and revealed that Lim-Dûl was behind it

events.summary: Darien consolidates his power, forms a single army under General Varchild, and allies with the Balduvians against Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: This allowed him to make an alliance with the Balduvians and lead an army against Lim-Dûl

events.summary: Twenty years into the Thaw, Darien and Lovisa merge their nations into New Argive and fight the Battle of Kjeldor.
events.quote: planned for their two nations to be merged into New Argive

events.summary: Darien duels Haakon from dusk till dawn; his men rush Haakon, who is overwhelmed and killed, ending the battle.
events.quote: Darien fought a duel against the zombie leader Haakon that lasted from dusk till dawn

relations.quote: he ruled over Kjeldor at the end of the Ice Age of Dominaria
